body.name: Stationary Brownian--GCM LR field
body.construction: From \(X(t)=\mathbb W(t)+t^2\), take its unrestricted GCM slope \(\mathfrak g\), impose the split slope constraint \(2x\) to obtain \(\mathfrak g_x^0\), and set \(D(x)=\int_{\mathbb R}\{[\mathfrak g(t)-2x]^2-[\mathfrak g_x^0(t)-2x]^2\}\,dt\).
